name: Amazon Prime

fastest.text: Go to amazon.com/gp/primecentral, sign in, then choose Manage membership and End membership.

steps: Sign in at amazon.com and open Account & Lists, then Prime Membership.
Select End membership and follow the prompts.
Confirm; Amazon shows the date your Prime benefits end.
note: Prime Video Channels such as Paramount+ keep running after Prime ends; cancel them separately under Memberships & Subscriptions. Signed up through Google Play or another company? Cancel with them.

faq.a: If you haven't used any Prime benefits in the current period, you're eligible for a full refund of that period. Amazon processes it in three to five business days.

faq.q: Do my Prime Video Channels stop too?
faq.a: No. Channels such as Paramount+ continue after your Prime membership ends, so cancel them separately.
Amazon sells a Prime Video membership on its own for $8.99/mo, and Prime for Young Adults is $7.49/mo for eligible students.
